answer_1.quote: AUTOCT leverages LLMs not simply for guidance but as active agents in the feature construction process. As shown in Figure , the system autonomously proposes, plans, and builds tabular features with extensive research.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include proposed, planned, and constructed tabular features for clinical trial prediction, as well as iterative feedback and error analysis for model improvement.

answer_2.quote: We use ROC-AUC as the primary performance metric to guide the tree search, in alignment with prior work such as Lo et al.

answer_3.quote: The Evaluator 2 plays a critical role in guiding the MCTS process by generating suggestions for improving model performance. These suggestions form the nodes explored in subsequent iterations of the AUTOCT pipeline.
